blocks.en: Understand biological evaluation as part of risk management, not a standalone test protocol

blocks.en: Master the two classification dimensions for medical devices: nature of body contact and duration of contact

blocks.zh: 第四節解析 — 一般原則
blocks.en: Clause 4 Notes - General Principles

blocks.zh: 核心概念：生物評估是「流程」，不是「一張測試清單」
blocks.en: Core Concept: Biological Evaluation Is a "Process", Not a "Test Checklist"

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1 最根本的邏輯：生物評估不是拿到器材就去做一批標準試驗。它是一個嵌入在 ISO 14971 風險管理框架之中的結構化流程。
blocks.en: The most fundamental logic of ISO 10993-1: biological evaluation does not mean taking a device and running a batch of standard tests. It is a structured process embedded within the ISO 14971 risk management framework.

blocks.zh: 這個流程的起點是「我們已知什麼？」，而不是「我們需要做哪些測試？」這個思維轉換非常重要——現有資料（材料規格、毒理文獻、供應商 CoA）可以取代全新的動物試驗。
blocks.en: The starting point of this process is "What do we already know?", not "Which tests do we need to run?" This change in mindset is very important - existing information (material specifications, toxicology literature, supplier CoAs) can replace brand-new animal studies.

blocks.zh: 有歷史安全使用記錄 → 可能不需要新測試
blocks.en: Documented history of safe use → new testing may not be needed

blocks.zh: 材料化學特性已充分建立 → 毒理閾值評估代替動物實驗
blocks.en: Material chemistry well established → toxicological threshold assessment in place of animal studies

blocks.zh: 等效於已評估器材 → 引用既有資料
blocks.en: Equivalent to an already-evaluated device → cite the existing data

blocks.zh: 類比：藥品杜撰對照 vs. 文獻引用
blocks.en: Analogy: Literature Reference vs. Starting from Scratch

blocks.zh: 想像一位毒理學家不是每個藥物都從頭做 LD50 試驗——如果化學物質的毒理資料庫已足夠充分，他會先做文獻回顧，只在資料缺口無法填補時才啟動新試驗。
blocks.en: Imagine a toxicologist who does not run an LD50 study from scratch for every drug - if the toxicology database for a chemical is already sufficient, he or she starts with a literature review and launches new studies only when a data gap cannot be filled otherwise.

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1 的生物評估邏輯完全相同：先找資料，再補缺口，最後才是新測試。
blocks.en: The biological evaluation logic of ISO 10993-1 is exactly the same: find existing data first, then fill the gaps, and only then run new tests.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務關聯：客戶提交的生物風險評估
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Biological Risk Assessments Submitted by Customers

blocks.zh: 在藥品 CDMO 的日常工作中，客戶（Sponsor/MAH）會在技術轉移包中附上容器/封閉系統的生物評估文件，這份文件的根據就是 ISO 10993-1。
blocks.en: In the day-to-day work of a pharmaceutical CDMO, the customer (Sponsor/MAH) includes biological evaluation documents for the container/closure system in the technology transfer package, and the basis of those documents is ISO 10993-1.

blocks.zh: CDMO QA 在審查這些文件時，應重點確認：
blocks.en: When reviewing these documents, CDMO QA should focus on confirming:

blocks.zh: 評估是否由「有資格的專業人員」執行並簽署（4.1 要求）
blocks.en: Whether the evaluation was performed and signed by a "qualified professional" (a 4.1 requirement)

blocks.zh: 是否列出所有接觸材料（玻璃瓶、橡膠塞、鋁蓋、包材）
blocks.en: Whether all contact materials are listed (glass vial, rubber stopper, aluminum cap, packaging materials)

blocks.zh: 是否說明不需要某項測試的理由（waiver justification）
blocks.en: Whether the reason for not needing a given test is explained (waiver justification)

blocks.zh: 4.9 觸發條件：若 CDMO 更換供應商或改變一級包材，必須通知客戶重新評估
blocks.en: 4.9 triggers: if the CDMO changes supplier or changes the primary packaging material, the customer must be notified so that re-evaluation can take place

blocks.zh: 4.3 — 評估範圍：不只是器材本體
blocks.en: 4.3 - Scope of Evaluation: More Than the Device Itself

blocks.zh: 許多人只想到器材本身，但 4.3 列出的 a~h 項目提醒我們，評估範圍包含：
blocks.en: Many people think only of the device itself, but items a to h listed in 4.3 remind us that the scope of evaluation includes:

blocks.zh: 包材：一級包材接觸到器材/藥品，可能間接傳遞化學物質給病人
blocks.en: Packaging materials: primary packaging contacts the device/drug product and may indirectly transfer chemical substances to the patient

blocks.zh: 加工助劑殘留：EtO 滅菌殘留（ISO 10993-7）、潤滑劑等
blocks.en: Processing aid residues: EtO sterilization residues (ISO 10993-7), lubricants and the like

blocks.zh: 降解產物：長期使用或高溫環境下的材料降解
blocks.en: Degradation products: material degradation during long-term use or in high-temperature environments

blocks.zh: 奈米材料：特殊挑戰，另有 ISO/TR 10993-22 規範
blocks.en: Nanomaterials: a special challenge, addressed separately in ISO/TR 10993-22

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填 CDMO，橡膠塞的矽油塗層、玻璃瓶的脫層問題都在此評估範圍之內。
blocks.en: In an aseptic filling CDMO, the silicone oil coating on rubber stoppers and delamination of glass vials both fall within this scope of evaluation.

blocks.zh: 4.5 — 測試結果不等於「零風險保證」
blocks.en: 4.5 - Test Results Are Not a "Zero-Risk Guarantee"

blocks.zh: 標準明確指出：test results cannot guarantee freedom from potential biological hazards。這意味著生物評估是持續進行的上市後監察（post-market surveillance）的一部分，而非一次性的批准行為。
blocks.en: The standard states clearly that test results cannot guarantee freedom from potential biological hazards. This means biological evaluation is part of continuing post-market surveillance, not a one-time approval.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的啟示：即使容器系統已通過所有生物相容性測試，上市後若出現不預期的不良反應，仍需重新評估（4.9e）。
blocks.en: Implication for a CDMO: even if a container system has passed all biocompatibility tests, re-evaluation is still required if unexpected adverse reactions occur after marketing (4.9e).

blocks.zh: 4.9 重新評估觸發點 — CDMO 場景對照
blocks.en: 4.9 Re-evaluation Triggers - CDMO Scenarios

blocks.zh: 更換橡膠塞供應商 → 觸發 4.9a，需重新評估
blocks.en: Change of rubber stopper supplier → triggers 4.9a; re-evaluation required

blocks.zh: 更改滅菌方式（gamma → EtO） → 觸發 4.9b
blocks.en: Change of sterilization method (gamma → EtO) → triggers 4.9b

blocks.zh: 延長產品效期 → 觸發 4.9c（儲存條件評估）
blocks.en: Extension of product shelf life → triggers 4.9c (evaluation of storage conditions)

blocks.zh: 藥品從靜脈注射改為肌肉注射 → 觸發 4.9d（接觸部位改變）
blocks.en: Drug product changed from intravenous to intramuscular injection → triggers 4.9d (change in contact site)

blocks.zh: 有病人回報疑似器材相關不良反應 → 觸發 4.9e
blocks.en: A patient reports a suspected device-related adverse reaction → triggers 4.9e

blocks.en: Nature of Contact - Summary Table

blocks.zh: Duration Categories — Summary Table 接觸時間類別 — 摘要表
blocks.en: Duration Categories - Summary Table

blocks.zh: 第五節解析 — 醫療器材分類
blocks.en: Clause 5 Notes - Categorization of Medical Devices

blocks.zh: 為什麼分類是生物評估的入口？
blocks.en: Why Is Categorization the Entry Point of Biological Evaluation?

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1 把分類放在評估流程的最前端（4.4 明確規定 evaluation shall commence with categorization），因為分類決定了後續 Annex A 的測試端點清單。
blocks.en: ISO 10993-1 places categorization at the very front of the evaluation process (4.4 states explicitly that evaluation shall commence with categorization), because categorization determines the list of test endpoints in the subsequent Annex A.

blocks.zh: 邏輯鏈：分類 → 測試端點矩陣 → 缺口分析 → 必要測試清單
blocks.en: Logic chain: categorization → endpoint matrix → gap analysis → required test list

blocks.zh: 錯誤分類會導致評估不足（under-evaluation）或過度測試（over-testing），前者有安全風險，後者浪費資源和動物。
blocks.en: Incorrect categorization leads either to under-evaluation or to over-testing; the former is a safety risk, and the latter wastes resources and animals.

blocks.zh: 類比：航空乘客安檢的分級
blocks.en: Analogy: Tiered Airport Passenger Screening

blocks.zh: 想像機場安檢：持本國護照的國內線旅客（非接觸類）只需一般安檢；持外國護照搭乘國際線（植入型，長期接觸）則需更嚴格的審查。
blocks.en: Think of airport security: a domestic passenger with a national passport (no-contact category) needs only ordinary screening, whereas a passenger on an international flight with a foreign passport (implant, long-term contact) faces much stricter checks.

blocks.zh: 器材與人體接觸越深、時間越長，生物相容性審查就越嚴格——這是 ISO 10993-1 分類系統的核心邏輯。
blocks.en: The deeper and longer a device contacts the human body, the stricter the biocompatibility review - this is the core logic of the ISO 10993-1 categorization system.

blocks.zh: CDMO 填充生產的容器分類思考
blocks.en: Thinking About Categorization of Containers in CDMO Filling Operations

blocks.zh: 在無菌藥品製造中，容器/封閉系統的分類取決於藥品的最終給藥方式：
blocks.en: In sterile drug manufacturing, the categorization of a container/closure system depends on the final route of administration of the drug product:

blocks.zh: 玻璃藥瓶（完整皮膚外部）：非接觸類 — 不需生物相容性評估
blocks.en: Glass vial (external to intact skin): no-contact category - biocompatibility evaluation not required

blocks.zh: 玻璃藥瓶（藥品供靜脈注射）：器材本身視為「Blood path, indirect」（間接血路接觸） — 需要評估，但透過 CoA 和既有資料常可支持
blocks.en: Glass vial (drug product for intravenous injection): the device itself is treated as "Blood path, indirect" - evaluation is required, but it can often be supported by a CoA and existing data

blocks.zh: 預填式注射器（Prefilled Syringe）：接觸循環血液 — 評估要求最嚴格，特別是注射器的矽油（silicone oil）和橡膠塞成分
blocks.en: Prefilled syringe: contacts circulating blood - the most stringent evaluation requirements, particularly for the silicone oil and the rubber stopper components of the syringe

blocks.zh: 植入式緩釋器材：組織/骨骼植入，長期暴露（C類）— 最高風險等級，需完整測試
blocks.en: Implantable sustained-release device: tissue/bone implant, long-term exposure (category C) - the highest risk level, requiring full testing

blocks.zh: 「累積接觸時間」的重要性 — 不是單次使用
blocks.en: The Importance of "Cumulative Contact Time" - Not a Single Use

blocks.zh: 5.3 特別強調是「cumulative sum」（累計總和），不是單次使用時間。這對一次性器材的重複使用場景特別重要。
blocks.en: 5.3 specifically emphasizes the "cumulative sum", not the duration of a single use. This is especially important for scenarios in which a single-use device is used repeatedly.

blocks.zh: 例如：透析患者每週使用血液透析器 3 次，每次 4 小時。單次 4 小時屬 A 類（有限暴露），但若考慮累積暴露，則必須以更高的分類（B 或 C）來評估。
blocks.en: For example: a dialysis patient uses a hemodialyzer 3 times a week, 4 hours each time. A single 4-hour use falls in category A (limited exposure), but when cumulative exposure is considered, the device must be evaluated under a higher category (B or C).

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：如果客戶的藥品是需要長期重複注射的（如生物製劑每月注射），則注射容器的材料評估必須考量累積效應。
blocks.en: CDMO practice: if the customer's drug product requires long-term repeated injection (for example, a monthly biologic injection), the material evaluation of the injection container must take cumulative effects into account.

blocks.zh: 類比：皮膚接觸 vs. 直接接觸血液的差異
blocks.en: Analogy: Skin Contact vs. Direct Blood Contact

blocks.zh: 想像手術室中的兩種手套：
blocks.en: Imagine two kinds of items in an operating room:

blocks.zh: 手術室外牆的橡膠手柄（接觸完整皮膚） → 表面接觸，A 類風險
blocks.en: A rubber handle on the outside wall of the operating room (contacts intact skin) → surface contact, category A risk

blocks.zh: 外科手術手套（接觸開放傷口） → 破損/受損表面接觸，風險大幅提升
blocks.en: Surgical gloves (contacting an open wound) → contact with breached or compromised surfaces, with a much higher risk

blocks.zh: 血液體外循環管路（直接接觸循環血液） → 最高風險，需要完整血液相容性測試
blocks.en: Extracorporeal blood circuit tubing (directly contacting circulating blood) → the highest risk, requiring full hemocompatibility testing

blocks.zh: 這個類比說明了為什麼 5.2 的分類從皮膚到血液，風險依次遞增。
blocks.en: This analogy shows why the categories in 5.2, from skin to blood, carry progressively higher risk.

blocks.zh: 分類練習 — CDMO 常見容器/封閉系統
blocks.en: Categorization Exercise - Common CDMO Container/Closure Systems

blocks.zh:
Type I 玻璃瓶 + 鹵丁基橡膠塞（供 IV 輸液）
→ 接觸性質：Blood path, indirect | 時間：有限暴露（A）（單次輸液 <24h）
blocks.en:
Type I glass vial + halobutyl rubber stopper (for IV infusion)
→ Nature of contact: Blood path, indirect | Duration: limited exposure (A) (single infusion <24 h)

blocks.zh:
預填充注射器（BD Uniject, insulin pen）
→ 接觸性質：Blood path, indirect（皮下）或 Circulating blood（靜脈）| 時間視頻率而定
blocks.en:
Prefilled syringe (BD Uniject, insulin pen)
→ Nature of contact: Blood path, indirect (subcutaneous) or Circulating blood (intravenous) | Duration depends on frequency of use

blocks.zh:
鋁製鋁蓋（未接觸藥品）
→ 接觸性質：非接觸類（間接包材），一般不需單獨生物評估
blocks.en:
Aluminum cap (not in contact with the drug product)
→ Nature of contact: no-contact category (indirect packaging material); a separate biological evaluation is generally not required

blocks.zh:
植入式藥物緩釋晶片
→ 接觸性質：Tissue/bone 植入 | 時間：長期暴露（C）→ 最嚴格評估
blocks.en:
Implantable drug-releasing chip
→ Nature of contact: tissue/bone implant | Duration: long-term exposure (C) → the most stringent evaluation

blocks.zh: 第六節解析 — 生物評估流程
blocks.en: Clause 6 Notes - The Biological Evaluation Process

blocks.zh: 六步驟生物評估流程（基於 Figure 1 精神）
blocks.en: The Six-Step Biological Evaluation Process (Based on the Spirit of Figure 1)

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1 Section 6 描述的流程可以整理為六個步驟：
blocks.en: The process described in ISO 10993-1 Clause 6 can be organized into six steps:

blocks.zh: Step 1：物理/化學特性表徵（6.1）— 收集材料組成、工藝殘留、降解產物等資料
blocks.en: Step 1: Physical/chemical characterization (6.1) - collect information on material composition, process residues, degradation products and so on

blocks.zh: Step 2：缺口分析（6.2）— 比較已有資料 vs. Annex A 所需資料集，識別缺口
blocks.en: Step 2: Gap analysis (6.2) - compare the data already available against the data set required by Annex A, and identify the gaps

blocks.zh: Step 3：選擇評估端點（6.2）— 根據分類結果決定需評估哪些生物學端點
blocks.en: Step 3: Select evaluation endpoints (6.2) - decide, based on the categorization result, which biological endpoints need to be evaluated

blocks.zh: Step 4：執行測試或引用現有資料（6.3）— 優先使用體外試驗，最小化動物試驗
blocks.en: Step 4: Perform testing or cite existing data (6.3) - give priority to in vitro tests and minimize animal testing

blocks.zh: Step 5：解讀資料（Section 7）— 毒理專家進行整合評估
blocks.en: Step 5: Interpret the data (Clause 7) - expert assessors carry out an integrated evaluation

blocks.zh: Step 6：撰寫生物評估報告 — 文件化所有決策邏輯和結論
blocks.en: Step 6: Write the Biological Evaluation Report - document all decision logic and conclusions

blocks.zh: 6.2 缺口分析（Gap Analysis）— 最關鍵的一步
blocks.en: 6.2 Gap Analysis - The Most Critical Step

blocks.zh: 缺口分析是生物評估流程的核心，也是最容易被忽視的步驟。它的邏輯是：
blocks.en: Gap analysis is the core of the biological evaluation process and also the step most easily overlooked. Its logic is:

blocks.zh: 先列出 Annex A 要求的資料集（根據器材分類）
blocks.en: First list the data set required by Annex A (according to the device categorization)

blocks.zh: 再盤點手上已有的資料（供應商文件、文獻、歷史測試）
blocks.en: Then take stock of the data already in hand (supplier documents, literature, historical tests)

blocks.zh: 比對兩者的差距 → 這就是「缺口」
blocks.en: Compare the two → the difference is the "gap"

blocks.zh: 決定如何填補缺口：追加資料？ 新測試？ 風險評估豁免？
blocks.en: Decide how to fill the gap: additional data? new testing? a risk assessment waiver?

blocks.zh: 重要提醒：藥典（BP/USP）的塑膠材料測試是針對原料，ISO 10993 評估的是最終器材狀態。藥典合格不代表可以直接替代 ISO 10993 測試，仍需說明理由（justification）。
blocks.en: Important reminder: the pharmacopoeial (BP/USP) tests for plastic materials apply to the raw material, whereas ISO 10993 evaluates the finished device state. Pharmacopoeial compliance does not mean it can directly replace ISO 10993 testing; a justification is still required.

blocks.zh: 類比：健康檢查的分項檢驗
blocks.en: Analogy: Itemized Tests in a Health Check-up

blocks.zh: 缺口分析就像醫生排健康檢查項目：不是所有人都需要做全套項目。
blocks.en: Gap analysis is like a doctor choosing the items for a health check-up: not everyone needs the full package.

blocks.zh: 20 歲健康男性：基本血液、尿液分析（有限接觸，低風險）
blocks.en: Healthy 20-year-old male: basic blood and urine analysis (limited contact, low risk)

blocks.zh: 50 歲有家族史：加做腸鏡、心臟超音波（更長接觸，更高風險）
blocks.en: 50-year-old with a family history: add colonoscopy and echocardiogram (longer contact, higher risk)

blocks.zh: 已有症狀：針對性深度檢查（已知問題需填補）
blocks.en: Already symptomatic: targeted in-depth examination (a known problem to be filled in)

blocks.zh: ISO 10993 的邏輯：器材接觸越深、越久，需要評估的端點越多，但有舊資料就不需要重做。
blocks.en: The logic of ISO 10993: the deeper and longer the device contacts the body, the more endpoints need to be evaluated, but where old data exist they do not need to be redone.

blocks.zh: E&L（Extractables & Leachables）在 CDMO 的核心地位
blocks.en: The Central Role of E&L (Extractables & Leachables) at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對於藥品 CDMO，6.1 提到的「extractables and leachables」是最直接相關的評估內容。
blocks.en: For a pharmaceutical CDMO, the "extractables and leachables" mentioned in 6.1 are the most directly relevant element of the evaluation.

blocks.zh: Extractables（可萃取物）：在極端實驗室條件下，從容器/封閉系統中可以萃取出的化學物質。這是最大可能的暴露量估算。
blocks.en: Extractables: chemical substances that can be extracted from the container/closure system under extreme laboratory conditions. This is an estimate of the maximum possible exposure.

blocks.zh: Leachables（可瀝出物）：在實際使用條件下（正常儲存、溫度、時間），實際遷移進入藥品的物質。這是病人實際暴露量。
blocks.en: Leachables: substances that actually migrate into the drug product under real conditions of use (normal storage, temperature, time). This is the patient's actual exposure.

blocks.zh: 評估流程：Extractables 研究 → 識別關鍵化合物 → 預測 Leachables → 與毒理閾值（TTC / SCT）比較 → 決定是否需要進一步測試。
blocks.en: Evaluation flow: extractables study → identify key compounds → predict leachables → compare with toxicological thresholds (TTC / SCT) → decide whether further testing is needed.

blocks.zh: 監管標準：ICH Q3D、ISO 10993-17（毒理閾值）、ISO 10993-18（化學表徵）。
blocks.en: Regulatory standards: ICH Q3D, ISO 10993-17 (toxicological thresholds), ISO 10993-18 (chemical characterization).

blocks.zh: 6.3.1 — 測試樣品必須是「最終器材」
blocks.en: 6.3.1 - The Test Sample Must Be the "Final Device"

blocks.zh: 這是許多廠商容易犯錯的地方：6.3.1a 明確要求測試樣品必須是最終器材狀態，包括滅菌後。
blocks.en: This is where many manufacturers go wrong: 6.3.1a explicitly requires that the test sample be in the final device state, including after sterilization.

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤：
blocks.en: Common errors:

blocks.zh: 用原料橡膠做測試，但實際產品橡膠已硫化、塗矽油 → 不符合要求
blocks.en: Testing raw rubber when the actual product rubber is vulcanized and siliconized → does not meet the requirement

blocks.zh: 滅菌前的樣品測試，未考慮 EtO 殘留或 gamma 輻射對材料的影響 → 需重新測試
blocks.en: Testing samples before sterilization without considering the effect of EtO residues or gamma irradiation on the material → retesting required

blocks.zh: 縮小版模型替代實際器材 → 需確認表面積/體重比的合理性（6.3.1b.5）
blocks.en: Using a scaled-down model in place of the actual device → the reasonableness of the surface area/body weight ratio must be confirmed (6.3.1b.5)

blocks.zh: 測試端點的風險分層邏輯 — CDMO 應用
blocks.en: Risk-Tiered Logic of Test Endpoints - CDMO Application

blocks.zh: 所有藥品容器系統都需考慮：細胞毒性（Cytotoxicity）、刺激性（Irritation）
blocks.en: Required for all drug product container systems: cytotoxicity, irritation

blocks.zh: 靜脈注射用途額外需要：血液相容性（Haemocompatibility）、熱原性（Pyrogenicity）
blocks.en: Additionally required for intravenous use: hemocompatibility, pyrogenicity

blocks.zh: 長期使用或植入額外需要：亞急性/慢性毒性、致癌性風險評估
blocks.en: Additionally required for long-term use or implants: subacute/chronic toxicity, carcinogenicity risk assessment

blocks.zh: 可降解材料需要：降解試驗（Degradation）、毒物動力學（Toxicokinetics）
blocks.en: Required for degradable materials: degradation testing, toxicokinetics

blocks.zh: 免疫原性未知材料：免疫毒性（Immunotoxicology）
blocks.en: Materials of unknown immunogenicity: immunotoxicology

blocks.zh: 第七節解析 — 評估資料解讀與風險評估
blocks.en: Clause 7 Notes - Interpretation of Evaluation Data and Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 「生物評估報告」的核心要素
blocks.en: Core Elements of the "Biological Evaluation Report"

blocks.zh: Section 7 的重點不是「做了哪些測試」，而是「有資格的人對所有資料做出了有文件記錄的判斷」。輸出文件稱為 Biological Evaluation Report（BER），它必須包含：
blocks.en: The focus of Clause 7 is not "which tests were done" but "a qualified person has made a documented judgment on all of the data". The output document is called the Biological Evaluation Report (BER), and it must include:

blocks.zh: 評估策略與範圍（a）
blocks.en: Evaluation strategy and scope (a)

blocks.zh: 可接受性標準（b）— 量化或定性的安全閾值
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria (b) - quantitative or qualitative safety thresholds

blocks.zh: 材料表徵充分性聲明（c）
blocks.en: A statement on the adequacy of material characterization (c)

blocks.zh: 每項測試選做或豁免的理由（d）— 這是稽核重點
blocks.en: The reason each test was selected or waived (d) - an audit focus

blocks.zh: 對現有資料的解讀（e）
blocks.en: Interpretation of the existing data (e)

blocks.zh: 是否仍有資料缺口（f）
blocks.en: Whether any data gaps remain (f)

blocks.zh: 整體生物安全結論（g）— 明確聲明材料是否適合預期用途
blocks.en: The overall biological safety conclusion (g) - a clear statement of whether the material is suitable for the intended use

blocks.zh: 誰可以撰寫 BER？資格要求
blocks.en: Who Can Write the BER? Qualification Requirements

blocks.zh: 標準要求 expert assessors — 在實際應用中，這通常意味著：
blocks.en: The standard requires expert assessors - in practice, this usually means:

blocks.zh: 具有毒理學背景（toxicologist，理想上是 ERT/DABT 等認證）
blocks.en: A toxicology background (a toxicologist, ideally certified, for example ERT/DABT)

blocks.zh: 了解 ISO 10993 系列標準的技術人員
blocks.en: Technical staff who understand the ISO 10993 series of standards

blocks.zh: 有器材生物安全評估實際經驗
blocks.en: Practical experience in the biological safety evaluation of devices

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO QA 的啟示：CDMO 不需要自己的毒理學家，但需要能審查客戶提交的 BER 是否符合此框架要求。如果 BER 缺少 d 項（豁免理由）或 g 項（整體結論），應要求補件。
blocks.en: Implication for CDMO QA: a CDMO does not need its own toxicologist, but it needs to be able to review whether a BER submitted by a customer meets the requirements of this framework. If the BER lacks item d (waiver justifications) or item g (overall conclusion), a supplement should be requested.

blocks.zh: 類比：法院判決 vs. 證據收集
blocks.en: Analogy: Court Judgment vs. Evidence Collection

blocks.zh: Section 6 的測試過程就像收集法庭證據，而 Section 7 是法官基於所有證據做出最終裁決。
blocks.en: The testing process in Clause 6 is like collecting evidence for a court case, and Clause 7 is the judge making the final ruling based on all the evidence.

blocks.zh: BER 就是這份判決書：它整合了所有化學資料、測試結果、文獻引用，並由「法官」（毒理學專家）寫下有理由的結論。
blocks.en: The BER is that judgment: it integrates all chemical data, test results and literature citations, and the "judge" (the toxicology expert) writes a reasoned conclusion.

blocks.zh: 如果稽核員看到 BER 只有測試數據表格而沒有專家解讀，這就等於只有「物證清單」沒有「判決書」——這不符合 ISO 10993-1 的要求。
blocks.en: If an auditor sees a BER that contains only tables of test data and no expert interpretation, that is a "list of exhibits" without a "judgment" - which does not meet the requirements of ISO 10993-1.

blocks.zh: CDMO QA 審查客戶 BER 的重點清單
blocks.en: Checklist for CDMO QA Review of a Customer BER

blocks.zh: 簽署人資格是否載明（toxicologist / qualified assessor）？
blocks.en: Are the signatory's qualifications stated (toxicologist / qualified assessor)?

blocks.zh: 是否列出所有接觸材料（包含 CDMO 使用的容器/包材型號）？
blocks.en: Are all contact materials listed (including the container/packaging material models used at the CDMO)?

blocks.zh: 每個測試豁免項目是否有書面理由？
blocks.en: Is there a written justification for each test waiver?

blocks.zh: E&L 研究結果是否已與毒理閾值（TTC/SCT）比對？
blocks.en: Have the E&L study results been compared against toxicological thresholds (TTC/SCT)?

blocks.zh: 整體安全結論是否明確——是「適合預期用途（fit for intended purpose）」的正面聲明？
blocks.en: Is the overall safety conclusion explicit - a positive statement that the device is "fit for intended purpose"?

blocks.zh: BER 版本是否涵蓋目前在 CDMO 使用的容器/封閉系統版本（非舊版器材）？
blocks.en: Does the BER version cover the version of the container/closure system currently used at the CDMO (not an older device version)?

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 更換過任何包材規格，客戶是否已更新 BER（對應 4.9 觸發條件）？
blocks.en: If the CDMO has changed any packaging material specification, has the customer updated the BER (corresponding to the 4.9 triggers)?

blocks.zh: 總結：Section 4-7 的邏輯鏈
blocks.en: Summary: The Logic Chain of Clauses 4-7

blocks.zh: 完整的生物評估思路：
blocks.en: The complete line of thinking in biological evaluation:

blocks.zh: Section 4：確立生物評估是風險管理的一部分，現有資料優先，專家主導
blocks.en: Clause 4: establishes that biological evaluation is part of risk management, with existing data first and experts leading

blocks.zh: Section 5：分類器材 → 接觸性質（表面/外部通訊/植入）× 接觸時間（A/B/C）
blocks.en: Clause 5: categorize the device → nature of contact (surface/external communicating/implant) × duration of contact (A/B/C)

blocks.zh: Section 6：收集物化資料 → 缺口分析 → 測試或引用資料（15個端點，按需選用）
blocks.en: Clause 6: collect physical/chemical data → gap analysis → test or cite data (15 endpoints, selected as needed)

blocks.zh: Section 7：毒理專家整合所有資料，形成有文件記錄的 BER，並聲明整體安全結論
blocks.en: Clause 7: toxicology experts integrate all data to produce a documented BER and state the overall safety conclusion

blocks.zh: 這四個 Section 共同構成了 ISO 10993-1 的骨幹，後面各 Part（10993-2 至 10993-20）都是在執行具體的測試方法，而此框架定義了「為什麼選這個測試」的決策邏輯。
blocks.en: Together these four clauses form the backbone of ISO 10993-1. The other parts (10993-2 to 10993-20) all implement specific test methods, while this framework defines the decision logic of "why choose this test".
